exposure: Etiological factors (cesarean section, hysterectomy for uterine rupture)
outcome: Typology of iatrogenic urogenital fistulas (vesicouterine, vesicovaginal, ureterovaginal fistulas)
cohort: The study included cases of iatrogenic urogenital fistulas (IUGF) operated between January 2020 and December 2023 at the Regional Hospital of Labe and the Ignace Deen University Hospital in Guinea.
finding: Iatrogenic urogenital fistulas, with a clear predominance of post-cesarean vesicouterine fistulas, represent an increasing share of fistulas in Guinea, and surgical management achieved a 100% closure rate.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as the main etiological factor, accounting for 78.57% of iatrogenic urogenital fistulas, predominantly vesicouterine fistulas.
